XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Exhaust system

  • Device: Exhaust gas pressure sensor

  • Fault: Intermittent engine fault light illumination, whilst the vehicle is operating correctly

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: P1205 (Particulate filter pressure sensor – Wiring/sensor/particulate filter fault)

  • Cause: Faulty exhaust gas pressure sensor

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the exhaust gas pressure sensor and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located underneath the vehicle, towards the passenger seat.
